subject: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help
messages:
From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@linaratech.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@linaratech.com
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help

Hi Ava —

Quick note from our side: we launched a targeted marketing push overnight and traffic spiked ~6x vs our forecast. We’re currently throttled on your API and it’s impacting a live feature for some customers.

Attached is a small usage snapshot (May + this morning) so you can see the jump. We need a short-term headroom increase for the next 48–72 hours while we throttle back the campaign and implement client-side rate limiting.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provision temporary quota/headroom ASAP and lift rate limits for our account for ~48 hours?
- Given we will run over our committed-tier for a brief window, can you propose an overrun rate or a short-term cap/discount for this event? Our procurement team is copied here and will need a formal price to approve.

We’re open to a one-time fee, a blended overrun rate, or a short-term addendum if that’s easier. This is urgent — any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Ari Patel
Head of Product
Linaratech
ari.patel@linaratech.com

Attachment: usage_snapshot_May2026.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@linaratech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help

Hi Ari —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the snapshot. I’m looping in Ben (pricing lead) and Lauren (account manager) so we can get you a concrete path. Two quick clarifying qs so we size the right response:
1) Do you have a target RPS / tokens-per-minute for the 48–72h window (rough estimate is fine)?
2) Is your priority minimal latency impact (i.e., keep current model + scale) or strictly cost minimization (downgrade model for the window)?

Ben — can you draft 1–2 options (emergency uplift + capped overrun vs 3-day uplift with discounted overrun) and we’ll aim to confirm by EOD PST.

Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avi Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Ari Patel <ari.patel@linaratech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help

Ava / Ari —

Quick proposal with two pragmatic options given the brief spike:

Option A — Emergency 48-hour uplift (fastest):
- Immediate headroom increase to allow current peak (we’ll provision equivalent of +5x historical peak for 48 hours).
- Overrun billing: blended overrun rate at $0.015 per generation token (pro-rated daily).
- One-time operational surcharge: $350 to cover rapid capacity provisioning.
- No contract amendment required; invoice will follow next billing cycle.

Option B — Short addendum (preferred if you want a small discount):
- 72-hour uplift (automated rollback at end).
- Blended overrun rate at $0.011/token for the three-day window, plus a $150 admin fee.
- We add a 30% credit on the overrun bill for day 1 (to offset the launch burst) if you sign the short addendum today.
- We can do a 30-day post-event reconciliation and roll the overrun into next month’s invoice or issue a separate charge — whichever procurement prefers.

Next steps:
- Ari: confirm which option you prefer (A or B) and give a PO number if procurement wants a PO.
- If you choose B, I’ll attach a one-page addendum draft for signature (pdf).

I’m available on the phone if you want to talk through numbers; otherwise we can implement the chosen option within 2 hours of confirmation.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: ava_proposed_quota_addendum_draft.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

From: Ari Patel <ari.patel@linaratech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@linaratech.com
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help

Ben / Ava — thanks for the quick options.

We’ll take Option B (72-hour uplift with the blended overrun rate). A couple of notes from procurement:
- We need a one-time invoice for the admin fee + statement of the estimated overrun cost so we can issue a PO today (PO will be provided within 2 hrs).
- Can Redwood commit to a hard rollback at the 72-hour mark (no automatic carryover)? That’s important for our finance forecasting.
- Also requesting a small onboarding concession — can you reduce the admin fee to $75 if we sign the addendum today?

If you can send the short addendum and the estimated cost line items, procurement will route the PO.

—Ari
Ari Patel
Head of Product, Linaratech
ari.patel@linaratech.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@linaratech.com>, procurement@linaratech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quota gap: urgent short-term uplift and pricing help

Ari / procurement —

Thanks — confirmed we will proceed with Option B and the automated rollback at 72 hours (we’ll enforce the rollback manually from the control plane to be explicit). Ben agreed to reduce the admin fee to $75 as a one-time concession given the purchase today.

Action items attached and next steps:
- Attachment: ava_proposed_quota_addendum_draft.pdf (please review, contains the exact uplift headroom, the $0.011/token blended overrun rate, the $75 admin fee, and rollback timing).
- Ben will generate an estimated overrun invoice line (based on your May + morning snapshot) and send to procurement within 60 minutes of this message.
- Procurement: please share the PO number and preferred invoice email (billing@linaratech.com?). Once we have the PO we’ll execute and provision the uplift (targeting provisioning within 90 minutes).

Thanks for the quick coordination — I’m marking this as in-progress and will confirm when uplift is live.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai
